title: Alch governed domain modeling product ontology
scope: The user-facing Alch capability from domain-language authoring through a reviewed construction handoff; compiler and runtime are replaceable realizations.

nodes.label: CyberAlchemy
nodes.meaning: The product that offers governed domain modeling.

nodes.label: Model governed domains with Alch
nodes.meaning: Express and review bounded domain meaning in a typed language before system construction.

nodes.label: Alch
nodes.meaning: The product language through which users express governed domain meaning.

nodes.label: Domain owner
nodes.meaning: Owns bounded business meaning and acceptance decisions.

nodes.label: Domain collaborator
nodes.meaning: Contributes examples, distinctions and evidence without silently acquiring decision authority.

nodes.label: System builder
nodes.meaning: Consumes accepted domain meaning for later construction without taking ownership of that meaning.

nodes.label: Author domain language
nodes.meaning: Turn domain knowledge into explicit typed declarations.

nodes.label: Review meaning and authority
nodes.meaning: Inspect definitions, relationships, examples, gaps, ownership and authority limits together.

nodes.label: Prepare deterministic construction
nodes.meaning: Produce a closed, traceable semantic input for a separately governed construction step.

nodes.label: Governed Domain Description
nodes.meaning: Owner-qualified domain language, evidence and unresolved required meaning.

nodes.label: Reviewed Domain Model
nodes.meaning: A coherent business ontology whose declarations retain their semantic kinds.

nodes.label: Construction-ready semantic handoff
nodes.meaning: A digest-bound candidate input to a separate compiler/construction process.

nodes.label: Shared bounded meaning
nodes.meaning: People and systems refer to the same owner-reviewed concepts and relations.

nodes.label: Less semantic rework
nodes.meaning: Ambiguity and non-collapse failures surface before they spread into code.

nodes.label: Traceable code intent
nodes.meaning: Later generated artifacts can trace back to explicit domain declarations.

nodes.label: Authority preservation
nodes.meaning: No language, validation, compilation or generation step grants business or effect authority.

nodes.label: Alch compiler
nodes.meaning: Checks and translates supported declarations without defining the product capability.

nodes.label: Alch runtime
nodes.meaning: May execute compiled behavior under separate bindings and grants; it does not own product meaning.

non_collapse: The product capability is not the compiler or runtime.
The reviewed domain model is not generated code.
A construction-ready handoff is not construction admission or authority.
A domain collaborator is not automatically the domain owner.
claim_ceiling: Complete for the bounded candidate product surface; no adoption, measured outcome, promotion, release or execution claim.
